item.title: Ram raiders use luxury SUV for Invercargill tobacco heist
item.description: Police said the raid happened at 5.15am today at a supermarket on North Road, Waikiwi. Photo: Google Maps Ram raiders made off with a "large amount" of tobacco and cigarettes after using a luxury SUV to smash through the front doors of an Invercargill supermarket.

item.title: Child serious after being hit by car in Invercargill McDonald's carpark
